To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) compiled communication on all optical networks can achieve performance that is close to that of a theoretical optimal solution and that (2) compiled communication on a 64-node all-optical TCM network can achieve performance that ranges from 3.2 to 6.4 times faster than a traditional communication method.

the compiler algorithms for supporting compiled communication in all-optical TMD networks are effective and that the performance of compiled communications is significantly better than that of the traditional communication method.

the performance of a compiled communication algorithm depends on the network topology, and that a compiled communication algorithm performs better than a traditional communication algorithm for some network topologies and some applications.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design and evaluation of compiler algorithms to support the implementation of compiled communication on multiprocessor systems with all-optical TMD networks.
the development of a compiler that can generate optimized programs for all-optical networks and the evaluation of the performance of the optimized programs on such networks.
developing a methodology and a compiler to support the compiled communication for parallel programs on multiprocessors.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

compiled communication is an efficient and practical communication technique for all-optical TTM networks, which is especially beneficial for applications with a large number of communication patterns.
compiled communication on all optical TDM networks is effective and efficient for many applications.
, in general, compiled communication is beneficial in terms of performance, and the performance benefit is more significant for programs that are communication intensive.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the compiler algorithms for supporting compiled communication on all- optical TDM networks are effective, and that compiled communication can improve application performance significantly.

we have developed a compiler that can support compiled communication for HPF programs, and we have demonstrated the effectiveness of compiled communications for HPF programs on all-optic TDM networks.
the experimental results show that the performance of compiled commu-nication is better than that of traditional communication for most of the programs we have tested.
The main takeaway from our work is that
compiled communication on alloptical TDM networks is effective for many HPF-like programs and can significantly improve performance.
compiled communication is very effective in all-optical TMD networks.
the performance of compiled communications on all-optical networks is comparable to or better than that of traditional communications.
